model_annotation: This chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms across different medical specialties, comparing a base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) against versions fine-tuned on six different specialty datasets. The horizontal axis is labeled "Per-specialty terms" and contains five category groups: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately -27 to -22, with tick marks at integer intervals. Each category group contains seven bars: one light blue bar representing Mistralv0.2-Base, and six bars representing models fine-tuned on Cardio (light yellow), Gastro (light orange), Infect (medium orange), Neuro (darker orange), Obstetrics (brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown). Across all five specialty term groups, the light blue Mistralv0.2-Base bar consistently reaches approximately -22, making it the tallest (least negative) bar in every group. The fine-tuned model bars are generally shorter, extending to more negative values, typically ranging between approximately -23.5 and -26.5. For the Cardio terms, the fine-tuned bars range from roughly -24 to -26.5, with the Cardio fine-tuned model appearing around -26 and others varying. For Gastro terms, the bars cluster between approximately -23.5 and -24.5. For Infect terms, the fine-tuned bars range from about -23 to -25. For Neuro terms, values span roughly -23.5 to -25. For Pediatrics terms, the fine-tuned bars cluster between approximately -23.5 and -24.5. The bars within each group are arranged in the same order as the legend, and no bars appear to be specially emphasized beyond their color coding.
